Context: 1. T.A. and Joining Time

- (b) On transfer.If the family does not accompany the Government servant, he will be paid T.A. on tour for self only for the transit period and will be permitted to carry personal effects up to V3 rd of his entitlement at Government cost; or can have the cash equivalent of carrying V3 rd of his entitlement or the difference in weight of the personal effects he is actually carrying and V3 rd of his entitlement, as the case may be, in lieu of the cost of transportation of baggage. Composite Transfer Grant
